transactions.notes: De-aggregated from a single 'Slovakia portfolio' row per rebuild-spec Task 2: the AR's Manager's-report narrative (line 1793-1795, line 1836/7968) gives only a PORTFOLIO-level figure -- 100% share sale of 5 Slovak property companies for a total EUR70.0m cash consideration, 'representing EUR2.3 million or 3.5% premium to the net asset value of EUR67.7 million as at 30 June 2025' -- but the audited p43 Divestments table separately discloses a per-property Divestment Price and Valuation for each of the 5 properties, which is used here. gain_loss_pct DERIVED per property = (9.1-9.3)/9.3 = -2.15%; note this per-property valuation-basis premium/discount is NOT the same computation as the portfolio-level 3.5% NAV premium (which used net equity value of the 5 SPVs, EUR67.7m, not the sum of the individual property valuations EUR72.4m) -- both are legitimate but distinct bases; the portfolio-level EUR70.0m consideration and 3.5% NAV premium are portfolio-only and are NOT repeated as sale_price/gain_loss_pct on this row (kept in notes only). Sum check: per-property divestment prices sum to EUR71.4m (matches the AR's separately disclosed 'total property price agreed' of EUR71.4m, line 1836) vs the EUR70.0m final cash consideration actually received -- the ~EUR1.4m gap is unexplained in the AR text at the per-property level and is recorded as-is, not reconciled by adjustment. Sum of per-property valuations = EUR72.4m (matches AR's disclosed portfolio valuation). Accounting gain on disposal of subsidiaries EUR1,181k per Note 5(a) (p201) is portfolio-level, not split per property.
